description: This file contains the PHP source code for the 'Banner' module controller in the OpenCart admin extension. It includes class definition, methods for displaying the banner module's configuration page ('index') and saving configuration ('save'), and handles interactions with models and views as part of the backend system.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Banner module Settings in the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the Banner module configuration page, loads language, sets title, prepares breadcrumbs, loads existing module info, banners, and view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update the Banner module configuration, manages permission checks, validation, and returns JSON response.
